concepts.definition: Durable technical intake-attempt state for one source-qualified, target-intent fingerprint. It records only source identity, target intent, lifecycle state and target receipt reference; it never stores the extracted candidate or becomes Contract business truth.
Explicit document-understanding operation against one immutable File revision; its head selects one fenced Intelligence processing revision.
Immutable Intelligence-owned processing lifecycle revision containing provider identity, untrusted raw output, optional explicitly saved output, bounded edits and failure evidence.
Immutable Intelligence actor/request fingerprint and exact processing revision receipt; it has no File upload request namespace.

Immutable copies of pre-cutover File processing runs, revisions and request receipts. They are read-only Intelligence evidence in a separate legacy request namespace and never participate in current processing replay.
Immutable operator marker proving one File-to-Intelligence processing-history copy by exact release revision, counts and canonical SHA-256 readback.

relationships.meaning: Vercel processor adapter implements the public IntelligenceProcessor contract. Intelligence owns processing lifecycle, evidence and Contract intake.

capabilities.intent: Execute only the explicitly user-selected compatible processor against a pinned File revision and produce untrusted Preview without implicit fallback or Save.

implementation.scope: Execute and persist an explicitly requested Intelligence processing lifecycle against a pinned File revision, retaining untrusted candidate and explicit save evidence.
implementation.note: Intelligence owns explicit processor selection, exact source authorization, output validation and its ProcessingRun lifecycle. Its native UTF-8 text Parser is local to Intelligence; configured provider adapters return untrusted candidate output. No OCR or Excel/Word Parser, asynchronous worker, automatic fallback, live provider or LINE device acceptance is asserted.

capabilities.intent: A user may locally edit Preview, then explicitly Save a version-bound result or Discard it; neither operation mutates downstream business owners.

implementation.scope: A user may locally edit Preview, then explicitly Save a version-bound result or Discard it; neither operation mutates downstream business owners.
implementation.note: Intelligence provides explicit Edit, Discard or version-bound Save of a Ready ProcessingRun. RawResult remains unchanged; no downstream business import, live LINE device or production acceptance is asserted.

capabilities.intent: Map explicitly supplied PDF or image evidence through the configured Vercel AI Gateway model into bounded, source-located candidate observations without approving, persisting or importing business facts.

implementation.scope: Vercel AI Gateway-backed PDF/image document understanding consuming File's public authorized source reader; Intelligence owns processor selection while hosts inject the provider port.
implementation.note: The processor preserves observations-v1:<model> identity, performs one provider attempt without fallback and supports configured PDF/JPEG/PNG/WebP inputs. Output remains candidate evidence; simulated tests do not prove live provider accuracy or acceptance.

capabilities.intent: Read an authorized File source, extract a complete purchase-order candidate using the target owner's schema, and submit it through the target's public SAVE command.

implementation.scope: Vercel AI Gateway-backed orchestration of exact File source read, target-owned schema extraction and Contract SAVE candidate submission.
implementation.note: A single durable provider attempt may produce only an untrusted SAVE candidate. Its technical state preserves source/intent identity and target receipt reference, never the candidate. Provider failure, response loss and live extraction accuracy remain distinct evidence boundaries.
